_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 15:34 ET AGAINST THE MANDATED ACCOUNT, AFTER A SCOPE PREFLIGHT THAT MATCHED THE MANDATE IDENTIFIER EXACTLY against the connector list - no first-account default, no nickname match, no balance heuristic; every other account was discarded unread and none is summarised, totalled or mentioned in this file, in runs.json, in why.json, in the commit message or in the operator report. Portfolio, equity positions and option positions were each queried live and all three returned first time: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, with buying_power reading 1009.16 to match - unchanged from every read since 8/27 because nothing has traded all week. BOTH POSITION LISTS ARE EMPTY, so no target, no -8% equity stop, no -40% option stop, no ~5 session time stop and no option no-fly window is reachable; that is discharged by evidence rather than excused. Orders of BOTH kinds on a created_at floor of 2026-08-26 return empty lists, which independently confirms nothing filled today and that the flatness is not a stale read carried forward from 15:21. THE WHOLE BALANCE IS SETTLED, so no good-faith violation is reachable and Monday's open sizes against the full 1009.16. THIS IS THE PRE-CLOSE, AND ITS ONE JOB IS THE OVERNIGHT DECISION: THERE IS NOTHING HELD, so nothing carries into tonight or into the weekend, and the flat book is recorded as a position rather than as an absence. It was not chosen this afternoon - it is the residue of an open slot that declined 116 minutes late and five hourly runs that each declined to patch a rule written for a different slot. THIS RUN PUBLISHED NO ORDER SPECIFICATION AND HAD NONE TO KILL AT THE BELL: why.json holds six entries dated 2026-08-28 before this one, all kind 'did', and not one 'will', the last will anywhere being 8/27 09:50 BOX at 34.50 which expired unexecuted at 15:30 YESTERDAY - so Step 3b is vacuous by the record rather than unchecked. It fired 15:34 ET against a 15:33 slot - ONE MINUTE LATE, the tightest arrival of the day and the fifth consecutive slot on time - and the clock was cross-checked against the venue rather than trusted, now-et.mjs reading 19:34:51.681Z against an AVGO venue_bid_time of 2026-08-28T19:35:47.705508949Z fifty-six seconds later, an exact -4 EDT offset. The scheduler item nonetheless STAYS OPEN: five clean fires prove the morning collapse was episodic, not that it was fixed, and the lost 10:17 row is still lost. NOTHING IS LIVE ON THIS BOARD. Both entryWatch rows are dead and are left exactly as written rather than re-dressed as though this run had re-verified their theses. The daily entry mandate ends the session UNDISCHARGED FOR A SECOND STRAIGHT DAY and is now unreachable by the rulebook's own text - it binds the OPEN slot, and the pre-close may not open a position in the last thirty minutes.

entryWatch.setup: BOX post-earnings DAY-2 continuation - reported 8/25 after the close, a 17.6% EPS beat, day one gapped and FADED below its own pre-print close and still finished green, and day two took out the day-one high on expanding volume. SPECIFIED at 09:50 at a 34.50 limit for 11 shares, CLEAN - no checklist item marked fail - and RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED six times at 10:21, 11:21, 12:21, 13:21, 14:21 and 15:21, the limit having traded through in every one of those six hours. EXPIRED UNEXECUTED at 15:30 ET.
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD, AND NOW OUT OF REACH AS WELL - which is a second and independent reason not to touch it. The fuse burned at 15:30 yesterday and the specification expired unexecuted, the sixteenth consecutive entry to do so, recorded by appending a did entry and never by editing the original. At 11:29 today BOX is 36.11 bid / 36.12 ask, +3.94% on the bid against a 34.740 settled close, leaving the 34.50 limit 1.61 or 4.46% BELOW the market. THE LIMIT IS NOT RE-STRUCK HIGHER - that is the refusal this board has made more often than any other and six times against this very limit yesterday, including at 14:21 when the limit was the offer itself. AND THE LEVEL WAS NEVER REVISITED TODAY: BOX opened 34.79 on a 5-cent gap and its session low is 34.655, fifteen and a half cents above the dead limit, then it closed its four half-hour bars at 35.270, 35.280, 35.670 and 36.110 on 314,945 shares. So a spec left alive into this morning would not have filled either. Yesterday's miss is a DELIVERY finding about a level that had to be hit inside its own session, and the only honest argument for re-striking - that the entry is still there - is false on the tape.
entryWatch.why: Item 1 is a dated number, not a chart: BOX reported fiscal Q2 2027 on 2026-08-25 after the close, EPS 0.40 against a 0.34 estimate, a 17.6% beat, verified on a live earnings-calendar pull covering 2026-08-24 to 2026-08-27. Item 2 passes on both limbs - BOX is +4.07% and the entry is struck at +3.32%, nowhere near the +8% line, and the day-one reaction bar is behind it, which is exactly the day-2/3 continuation the rulebook prefers over the spike. The second limb of item 2, the whole-list-green wait signal, was tested rather than waved through: the tape is broadly green but it is NOT uniform, with BBY -4.69%, HQY -13.72%, HPQ -7.90%, HRL -6.54%, BBWI -5.19%, DLTR -2.65%, INTU -2.78% and BURL -1.87% all red on their own numbers, and BOX is not part of the AI complex that is doing the leading. Item 3 does not bind and is logged na rather than skipped: BOX's next report is roughly late November, verified as no upcoming dated event inside the five-session window, so there is no earnings hold for a straddle to precede. Item 4 is the strongest reading on the board - a 0.057% spread on 5.96M shares yesterday against 1.4-4.3M in the week before. Item 5 reads the right way: BOX traded 31.93 to 33.79 for the two weeks into the print and was not run up, and on day one the sellers got a 32.6637 print BELOW the pre-print close and the name still closed green. Item 6 is discharged here in writing before entry.

entryWatch.setup: SMTC day-2 after the 8/25 print - the name this board specified at 138.50 on 8/26 and never got filled on
entryWatch.trigger: NOT RE-STRUCK, AND REFUSED TWICE OVER ON INDEPENDENT GROUNDS. SMTC is 144.20 bid / 144.49 ask at 13:41:56.037586273Z, last 144.290, +2.48% against a 140.800 close and 3.90% ABOVE the 138.50 limit that expired unexecuted at 15:30 yesterday. FIRST REFUSAL, the one this board has made most often: buying it here is re-striking a dead level higher, which is the FUTU 117.90 refusal, the BJ 97.35 refusal made twice, the BZ refusal made yesterday morning, and the refusal made against this board's own live SMTC entry at 14:21 yesterday when raising to 139.16 would have bought the high of the afternoon. Widening the time is not permission to widen the price, and that rule does not stop applying because the level got away. SECOND REFUSAL, independent of the first and decided on 2026-08-21: moves.json branch one refuses any entry in the AI or semiconductor complex on 8/27 into the MRVL print, which is tonight. Either one alone kills it. Yesterday's thesis is unchanged and is not re-argued - a 24.6% beat on a name marked down 21.6% into its own print - and the fifteenth consecutive unexecuted entry remains a DELIVERY failure rather than a thesis failure, which is the finding the retro already carries.
entryWatch.why: The 8/26 entry was FORCED on items 2 and 3 and every marking stands as struck. It was re-quoted and confirmed six times, all three pre-registered invalidations were tested mechanically at every hour and not one ever tripped, and the limit was refused downward at 136.50 and 135.56 and upward at 139.16. It died marketable and the miss cost 2.35 a share against the 140.85 bell. None of that makes 144.20 an entry.

candidatesNote: THIS IS NOT A SURVEY AND THE PRE-CLOSE DOES NOT RUN ONE - a slot that may not open a position has no business assembling the evidence for one. ONLY TWO ROWS WERE RE-QUOTED LIVE, BOX and AVGO, plus SPY off-list for the clock cross-check at 769.30 bid against a 771.10 close, the tape closing a quiet 0.23% red. Every other row still carries its 8/27 09:4x-15:35 quote and timestamp and MUST be read as of those times, NOT as of now. NO EXIT WAS DUE: equity and option positions were both queried live and both returned empty, so no target, stop, time stop or option no-fly window is reachable - the reason is that nothing is held, not that nothing was checked, and that distinction is this slot's entire job. NOTHING IS HELD OVERNIGHT, so the overnight decision resolves to no exposure rather than to a hold, and no straddle is owed on any name because no position would carry into a print. NO SPECIFICATION WAS LIVE EITHER and that is established by reading the log rather than by an afternoon passing quietly - why.json carries six 'did' entries dated 8/28 and not one 'will', so there was no unexpired proposal to kill at the bell. The mandate binds the OPEN slot by its own text and is NOT transferred here; it ends the day undischarged for a second straight session and the retro owns that gap. BOX IS STILL THE NUMBER THAT CUTS AGAINST THIS BOARD AND IT CUT HARDEST IN THE LAST HOUR: yesterday's expired 34.50 is 35.24 bid, the lowest read of the day, the session ladder running 36.11, 35.70, 35.59, 35.58, 35.35, 35.24 - the gap has narrowed in every reading since noon to 0.74 or 2.10% under the bid, from 1.61 at 11:29. It is NOT RE-STRUCK, for the eleventh time. A level walking back toward a dead limit is precisely when that refusal earns its keep, because it is the hour in which chasing would feel most like patience, and it would be refused identically at 34.51.

candidates.note: RE-QUOTED LIVE AT 15:34 ET INTO THE BELL - one of only two rows in this list that was. 35.24 bid / 35.25 ask at 2026-08-28T19:35:47.927843753Z, last 35.240, +1.44% on the bid against a 34.740 settled close, on a 0.028% spread. THE NAME CAME IN ALL AFTERNOON AND CLOSES AT ITS LOWEST HOURLY READ OF THE DAY: the full session ladder is 36.11, 35.70, 35.59, 35.58, 35.35, 35.24. The flag stays watch rather than nofly because the two are different facts - the name carries no blocking event, its print is behind it, and nothing here says it is untradeable. What it is NOT is buyable by this board today, and that was never close. Yesterday's 34.50 specification expired unexecuted at 15:30 and the limit still rests 0.74 or 2.10% UNDER the bid, so any entry here is re-striking a dead level higher, which is refused. THIS IS THE HOUR THAT REFUSAL WAS WORTH SOMETHING: the gap has narrowed in every reading since noon - 1.61, 1.20, 1.09, 1.08, 0.85, 0.74 - so the level has walked back toward the dead limit all session and the temptation grew monotonically while the answer did not move. It would be refused at 34.51 exactly as at 35.24. The level was also never revisited this session: the open was 34.79 and the low 34.655, both above the dead limit, so a spec left alive into today would not have filled either. Had the 11 shares filled at 34.50 they would be up 8.14, about 0.81% of the account.

THE BEST SETUP ON THE TAPE AND REFUSED BY THIS BOARD'S OWN PRE-REGISTERED BRANCH, NOT BY A CHECKLIST ITEM. 203.09 bid / 203.30 ask at 13:46:54.235014795Z, last 203.485, +0.42% against a 202.250 close, on a 0.103% spread - the tightest of roughly sixty names quoted this morning. The setup: a day-2 continuation of ANET's own 8/26 breakout, which closed 202.25 AT the session high on 7,664,556 shares against 4.2-5.7M in the four sessions before it, out of the 183.75-190.94 base it had built since 8/20; today it opened 205.155, printed a 206.10 high, based 201.39-203.73 and was rebuilding. Earnings 2026-11-03 on a live pull, so no event inside the time stop. Item 2 passes at +0.42%. THE REFUSAL: moves.json branch one, written 2026-08-21 and widened on that same date to include 8/27 precisely so this morning could not fall through the gap, refuses any entry in the AI or semiconductor complex on 8/27 into the MRVL print, which is tonight. The entire ANET thesis is that it is the NVDA datacenter read-through, so it cannot be a sympathy name for the thesis and not one for the refusal. A five-session hold opened today wears the MRVL gap and a -8% stop cannot be honoured across it. The intended entry, recorded so the refusal can be graded: 1 share at a 202.25 limit - the retest of the 8/26 breakout close - stop 186.07, target 242.70. Note the size finding: the 40% ceiling permits 2 shares only at a limit of 201.83 or below, 42 cents under the level the thesis names, so the level was kept and the size given up.

224.39 bid / 224.41 ask at 13:45:17.001971557Z, +7.03% against a 209.660 close on a 0.01% spread. The catalyst itself: fiscal Q2 2027 EPS 2.22 against a 2.09 estimate, reported last night, verified true on a live calendar pull. Refused on three grounds, any one sufficient. Item 2 - the session high of 225.03 is +7.33%, a tenth of a point off the +8% line, and this is the day-one reaction bar, which the rulebook says is not the entry. Structure - 225 is the TOP of the 8/10-8/17 congestion, whose highs run 224.14, 225.10, 227.23, 227.49 and 227.92, so the gap lands directly into overhead rather than into clear air. And branch one refuses the complex on 8/27 into tonight's MRVL print regardless. Two shares would also be 44.5% against the 40% ceiling, so the position would be one share at 22.2% in any event.

67.76 bid / 68.16 ask at 13:42:21.344152061Z, +3.63% against a 65.390 close on a 0.59% spread. A 39.5% EPS beat - 0.60 against 0.43 - and refused on the SHAPE OF THE TAPE rather than the number, which is numbers-over-narrative pointing the unusual way. It opened 71.61, printed 74.42 in the 09:32 minute and has fallen in EIGHT CONSECUTIVE MINUTES since, 74.42 to 67.70 by 09:42, giving back the entire gap on rising volume. That is a day-one gap-and-fade in progress, not the day-2 pullback the rulebook buys, and there is no shelf to strike a limit at because the name has not stopped going down. BOX is the same trade one day further along and with the fade already behind it, which is why BOX was taken and this was not.

97.11 bid / 97.15 ask at 13:48:27.047766393Z, +3.50% against a 93.830 close on a 0.04% spread. Same slot as BOX - reported 8/25 after the close, and it BEAT, 1.55 against 1.38, up 12.3%. Refused because the day-one reaction was a 7.0% DECLINE: 8/25 closed 100.92, 8/26 opened 95.20 and closed 93.83 on 7.28M shares. A beat the market sold is a guidance or a mix problem this run cannot see, and today's +3.5% is a bounce off that decline rather than a continuation of anything. BOX is the same calendar slot with the opposite day-one shape - faded and still closed green - and that difference is the entire reason one was published and the other was not.

CORRECTED AT 15:35 AGAINST A LIVE PULL, WHICH THE NUMBERS-OVER-NARRATIVE TIEBREAK REQUIRES: DG's actual is 2.23 against a 1.99 estimate, a 12.1% BEAT - not the 2.48 and 24.6% this row carried from 09:50, which is SMTC's figure and appears to have crossed rows. The correction does not change the conclusion and the conclusion is not re-argued to fit it. Quote unchanged from the open slot and to be read as of then: 128.42 bid / 128.91 ask at 13:48:28.085820098Z, +4.59% against a 122.780 close on a 0.38% spread. Still NOT taken, for the two reasons given at 09:50. It is day ONE, and the rulebook says the reaction day is not the entry, the day-2 or day-3 pullback that holds is. And the read-across cuts against it: every other retail name that beat this morning is being SOLD - BBY -4.69%, DLTR -2.65%, BURL -1.87% - so DG is the exception in a group the tape is rejecting, which is a reason to want the second day rather than the first. Worth the 8/28 open's attention if it holds. Note that the smaller true beat weakens the catalyst slightly rather than strengthening it.
